newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RAND LEASES BUYS STAKE IN GF PROP.
newsitem.headline: RAND LEASES BUYS STAKE IN GF PROP.

text.p: Rand Leases Property Ltd said on Monday it planned to acquire 43.1 percent of Gold Fields Property Ltd for 48.5 million rand.

In terms of the deal, the sellers of the stake -- Gold Fields Mining and Development Ltd, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Gold Fields of South Africa Ltd , New Wits Ltd and The National Trust of Africa Ltd, a wholly-owned subsidiary of New Wits -- had agreed to sell 4.41 million shares in Gold Fields Property to Rand Leases.
The acquisition would be effective seven days after Rand Leases linked unitholders had approved it, the company said.
It said the acquisition would provide the Gold Fields Property operations with access to its management expertise and would serve to unlock additional value in the future.
Rand Leases added that it was in further discussions which, if successfully concluded, could have an impact on its linked units on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.
It advised unitholders to exercise caution in their dealings in Rand Leases linked units until further notice.
